# MouseDown <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MouseDown:Int32 button:Int32, device:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | In | Int32 | required | 1 for the left, 2 for the right, 3 for the middle button, 4 for the back (X1) and 5 for the forward (X2) button. |
| `device` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Only look at this mouse, counted from 0 as in MouseDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all mice together. |

**Returns:** 1 while the button is held down, otherwise 0.

## Description

Tells whether a mouse button is held down at this moment.

## Differences

* Buttons 4 and 5 (the back and forward buttons) are a BlitzLLVM extension. A button number outside 1 to 5 always gives 0.
* The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	If MouseDown(1) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 80, 80, 80
	Rect 20, 60, 80, 80, 1
	If MouseDown(3) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 80, 80, 80
	Rect 120, 60, 80, 80, 1
	If MouseDown(2) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 80, 80, 80
	Rect 220, 60, 80, 80, 1
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Text 160, 200, "Hold a mouse button", 1, 1
	Flip
Wend
```
